messages:
sam: Quick proposal — I want to try an 'ephemeral bridge' gate for model onboarding. Goal: avoid single-signal rollbacks by requiring a quorum across metric groups before we promote a quantized candidate. Pls skim the config snippet below and shout if it clashes with rollout infra./link

maria: Love the idea. Can you clarify how quorum handles noisy slices (longdocs, code)? Those blow up variance and can veto too often.

lee: Two quick constraints: (1) emergency fallback if p99 latency or 5xx error rate jumps >20% (instant), (2) quorum uses weighted groups so a fidelity-only minor dip doesn't block when latency/cost win big.

sam: Exactly — plan is 3 groups: fidelity, latency, cost. Require majority of groups to pass, and within fidelity group require at least 2/3 slice-cohorts passing. Sketch: 
```yaml
gate:
  quorum:
    groups:
      - fidelity: [concordance, hallucination_rate]
      - latency: [p50, p95, p99, error_rate]
      - cost: [tokens_per_req, avg_infer_ms]
    require_majority_groups: 2
    fidelity_slice_threshold: 0.98     # per-slice concordance pass rate
    per_slice_weighting: true
    emergency_instant_fallback_if:
      latency_or_error_increase_pct: 20
```

nina: FYI smoke A/B I ran on the int4 candidate (v2-int4) vs baseline (v2):
- overall concordance: -0.3%
- longdoc slice concordance: -2.4%
- hallucination rate (longdoc): +0.8pp
- p99 latency: +15ms
- token cost: -34%

alex: Hmm, longdoc looks concerning. But cost win is huge. Suggest we weight longdoc lower initially (bootstrapped weight 0.6) and require staged traffic: start 1% -> 5% -> 20% with re-eval windows.

maria: Agree with staged traffic. Also add a conservative tie-breaker: if exactly 1 group passes and the failing group's delta is within noise band (0.2 sigma) then allow a soft-promote but keep shadow comparing for 48h.

lee: Operational note: the rollout controller needs to support per-slice holdouts and runtime tie-breaker flag. Devops, can we get a flag? @devops-bot please schedule a quick task.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-2042 'ephemeral-bridge-gate: per-slice weights + emergency fallback' — eta devs: 2d, infra: 1d. Link: https://jira/redwood/INF-2042

sam: For monitoring, propose these alert triggers while in staged traffic:
- fidelity group fail rate across slices > 1% absolute -> notify oncall
- p99 latency increase > 15% for 5m window -> instant rollback
- hallucination delta > 0.5pp sustained 1h -> auto-toggle rollback

nina: Also capture qualitative evals (5 example fails per hour) to a private folder for rapid triage — automation already exists, just wire it to the new gate.

alex: Last thought: add a small A/B concordance baseline check (synthetic prompt corpus) as final smoke before 20% cutover. If that fails, hold.

sam: Cool — I'll update the proposal with weights and staged thresholds and paste back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
